findings.current: Because of mounted bandits like you, the place nearly turned into a battlefield moments ago, then things quieted down over the last few years.
findings.defect: “Moments ago” places the near-conflict in the present, contradicting the subsequent years of calm.
findings.rationale: The source describes a past crisis followed by several quiet years, not a crisis moments before this conversation.
findings.replacement: Because of mounted bandits like you, the place nearly became a battlefield, but it’s been quiet for the past few years.
findings.source: 너희 같은 마적 놈들 때문에 말판 촌각 전까지 갔다가 근 몇 년 동안은 잠잠해졌다고.

findings.current:
“I’ve been taking the long way around, haven’t I?”

The meaning behind Jeok Cheongang’s low question was clear. Ma Junggeol took a deep breath and spoke again.
findings.defect: The first-person line sounds like Ma Junggeol commenting on his own story, though Jeok Cheongang is the one speaking and pressing him to get to the point.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly identifies the question as Jeok Cheongang’s.
findings.replacement:
“That’s enough preamble, isn’t it?”

Jeok Cheongang’s low question left no doubt what he meant. Ma Junggeol took a deep breath and spoke again.
findings.source: “서두가 길었군. 그렇지 않으냐?” 착 가라앉은 적천강의 물음에 담긴 의미는 명백했고, 크게 심호흡한 마중걸이 재차 입을 열었다.

findings.current: Honestly, I wanted to turn around and leave the Chief and the rest behind.
findings.defect: The speaker wanted to abandon the whole venture and return, not specifically desert the Chief and the other men.
findings.rationale: 대형이고 나발이고 dismisses even the Chief as a reason to continue; 죄다 엎어 버리고 refers to scrapping the undertaking.
findings.replacement: Honestly, I wanted to say to hell with the Chief and the whole damn venture and turn back.
findings.source: 솔직히 그때는 대형이고 나발이고 죄다 엎어 버리고 돌아가고 싶었소.

findings.current: Just so you know, my brothers and I like grain liquor best of all.
findings.defect: Naming liquor outright removes Ma Junggeol’s playful euphemism in response to the offer of tea.
findings.rationale: 곡차 literally presents alcohol as “grain tea”; the following reply about their reputation as drinkers makes the joke clear.
findings.replacement: Just so you know, of all the teas, my brothers and I favor grain tea most.
findings.source: 저와 제 아우들은 차 중에서도 곡차(穀茶)를 제일로 칩니다.

findings.current: Whew, look at you, getting your voice back now that you’ve caught your breath.
findings.defect: “Caught your breath” suggests recovery from exertion rather than renewed swagger once the immediate pressure has eased.
findings.rationale: 숨통 좀 트였다고 points to having room to breathe after Jeok Cheongang’s earlier intimidation.
findings.replacement: Whew, look at you raising your voice again the second you’re out of trouble.
findings.source: 어후, 숨통 좀 트였다고 다시 목소리 커진 거 봐.

summary: The draft has actionable errors in chronology, speaker attribution, and the brothers’ account of the journey.
